nodes.title: Welcome to Da Nang
nodes.canDo: I can say where Da Nang is and what its name means.
nodes.reading: Da Nang is a city in Central Vietnam. It is on the sea. It has a big river, the Han River. The name “Da Nang” comes from the Cham language. It means “big river”. Da Nang is near Hue and Hoi An.

vocabulary.definition: a big town where many people live and work
water that flows to the sea
vocabulary.example: The Han River is in Da Nang.

vocabulary.definition: a very large area of salt water
vocabulary.example: The city is on the sea.

vocabulary.definition: the word we call a person or place
vocabulary.example: What is the name of the city?
Da Nang is in Central Vietnam.
Hoi An is near Da Nang.

nodes.title: Hot and rainy
nodes.canDo: I can say simple things about the weather in Da Nang.
nodes.reading: Da Nang is hot and humid. The weather is warm all year, about 25 or 26 degrees. There are two seasons. The dry season is from January to August. The rainy season is from September to December. In summer it can be 33 to 36 degrees.

vocabulary.definition: with a lot of water in the air

vocabulary.example: It rains in the rainy season.

vocabulary.definition: one of the 12 parts of a year

questions.prompt: What is the weather in Da Nang like?

questions.explanation: There is a dry season and a rainy season.

questions.explanation: Rainy season: September–December.

questions.explanation: Da Nang is a warm, tropical city.

questions.explanation: Summer can reach 33–36°C.

questions.prompt: It rains more in the ___ season.
questions.explanation: The rainy season has more rain.

nodes.title: Noodles of Da Nang
nodes.canDo: I can name some Da Nang dishes and say what I like.
nodes.reading: Da Nang has many tasty noodle dishes. Mi Quang has rice noodles, pork, shrimp, peanuts and fresh herbs. Bun cha ca is noodles with fish. Bun mam nem is noodles with a strong fermented sauce. Banh trang cuon thit heo is pork rolled in rice paper with herbs. These are famous local dishes.

vocabulary.definition: long food made from rice or wheat
an animal that lives in water; also food
a small sea animal we eat

vocabulary.example: Pork is rolled in rice paper.

nodes.title: The Dragon Bridge
nodes.canDo: I can describe a famous bridge with simple sentences.
nodes.reading: The Dragon Bridge is in Da Nang. It crosses the Han River. The bridge looks like a dragon. It is long and bright at night. At night the dragon can breathe fire and water. People come to watch the show.

vocabulary.definition: a structure that crosses a river

vocabulary.definition: the dark part of the day

nodes.canDo: I can describe an old place with simple words.
